title: Trace a worker incident
task: Save one worker name per 5xx event in input order to failed-workers.txt. Count failures per worker in failures.txt, sorted by worker with a single space between count and name. Save the owning team of the most affected worker to owner.txt.
hints: Read the status as the third field.
Sort worker names before counting equal lines.
Pick the worker with the highest count and look up its team with jq.

demo.explanation: Filter the numeric status field before counting.
Use the inventory to map the worker name to a team.

checks.label: Failure counts match the incident
